messages:
jamie: FYI — cust reported their ingest pipeline started failing after we pinned their model to a reserved variant. Embedding length went from 1536 -> 1024. payloads rejected by downstream DB with shape mismatch. request_id: req_2026_03_12_88ab

jamie: sample error from customer: \"AssertionError: expected vector len 1536, got 1024\"

maria: Can you paste the variant name they were pinned to and a raw API response? Also any recent canary notes?

jamie: pinned to `embed-open-qa:v2.1.2-locked` (customer-facing alias). Here's a sanitized curl they provided:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACT\" \\\n  -d '{"model":"embed-open-qa:v2.1.2-locked","input":["foo"]}'
```
response body (sanitized):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001, ... ,0.999] /* length: 1024 */}],"model":"embed-open-qa:v2.1.2-locked"}
```

ollie: interesting — we pushed a batching change in the runtime that flips pad orientation for some quantized variants (leader merge optimization). Most models are unaffected because they re-pad on the CPU path, but pinned variants that skip the re-pad step can return the truncated axis.

jamie: ugh. customer is ingesting directly into vector DB (no pad/resize step) so they break immediately. customer is onboarding today, high priority.

embed-checker-bot: ran quick diag on `embed-open-qa:v2.1.2-locked` -> reported native_vector_len: 1536, served_vector_len: 1024, last_deploy: 3381200000, batching-mode: continuous, quant-mode: q8a

maria: mitigation options: 1) roll back pin to previous variant on their tenant (fast) 2) patch runtime to restore trailing-pad behavior for pinned quantized variants (longer) 3) temporary gateway shim to expand vectors to 1536 with zeros (hack-y, but minimal customer impact)

ollie: I'll open ENG-INC-5429 to track the runtime fix (likely a tensor layout mismatch introduced in commit 1f4c2). For immediate fix I can re-generate the pinned variant with the re-pad step included (will take ~30m to build + smoke).

jamie: please do the regen, and I'll offer the customer the rollback if they prefer immediate remediation. I'll also share the request_id and logs with SRE. @maria feel free to escalate to oncall if we need infra change. :thumbsup:

maria: will stand by. jamie — ping me when you have chosen rollback vs regen. If we roll back I can trigger the tenant rollback flow (no downtime, config-only revert).

ollie: regen started (job 4492). I'll post smoke results here when done.

embed-checker-bot: smoke result (job 4492): served_vector_len now 1536 for sample inputs, canary latency OK, quant checksum match.

jamie: relayed to customer: they confirmed ingest succeeded after we switched to regenerated pinned variant. They've asked for post-mortem and root cause. I'll open a support ticket to keep them updated.

ollie: root cause notes for the post-mortem: batching optimization changed pad orientation for q8 variants; pinned variants skipped CPU re-pad path -> truncated output. Fix will ensure re-pad is applied for pinned/locked variants or the kernel preserves channel-last orientation.

maria: adding follow-up tasks: add canary test for pinned variants (embedding length assertion), and an alert on vector-length delta > 0 for tenant rollouts.

jamie: thanks team — marking this resolved for now. I'll file the PM and include reproduction steps + fix timeline. :white_check_mark:
